findings.message: L1: authored pickup procedures and nominal targets do not certify physical settings: mechanical dial calibration and dial-to-part registration are unverified; source graduations and nominal targets do not establish physical dial settings. Unknown: X physical dial setting, Z physical dial setting, calibration, backlash, X direction, Z direction.

x.procedure: Touch the OD, withdraw the tool clear and set the cross-slide ring to the closest whole dial number; record that starting reading before cutting. Its engraved 0.002-inch graduations indicate diameter reduction, not radial travel; nominal spindle-axis X0 is not a physical dial setting.

z.face: raw exposed brass end, then the faced front annulus
z.method: Touch the raw face until a first chip appears; withdraw radially, advance the carriage for facing and lock. Establish the faced end as the later nominal axial reference. Record the actual initial end station and verify sign/reversal checks before relying on this pickup.
z.procedure: Touch the raw exposed face, withdraw radially, advance the carriage for facing and lock it. The resulting front face is the axial reference. For the groove tool in L1 op 100, set the ring-side cutting edge 0.100 inch behind that face with a machinist scale and lock the carriage. Use this scale pickup; do not make a paper/top retouch after L1 op 80.

readout.debt: mechanical dial calibration and dial-to-part registration are unverified; source graduations and nominal targets do not establish physical dial settings
readout.procedure: For OD turning, touch the stock surface, withdraw clear and rotate the cross-slide graduation ring to the closest whole number; record the starting dial number and read subsequent DIAMETER reductions from that physical dial. Set the groove's ring-side Z edge with the machinist scale.

tool_touches.method: Use the machinist scale to place the ring-side edge 0.100 inch behind the faced end; lock carriage. This is a scale pickup, not a paper/face touch. Do not substitute the unmeasured tool width for the ring width.
tool_touches.x_method: Touch the finished OD and read diameter reduction on the physical handwheel. Record the initial dial reading and verify the backlash/take-up procedure before cutting.
